title: Tinsel on the ramp
logline: A strand of tinsel wound along Gully's ramp rail in December, the pup going up under it, the string lights on the eave above. The first private Christmas the page allows itself, in tinsel.

panels.composition: A plank ramp at a shingle shack's door with tinsel wound along its rail and colored lights along the eave above, a small three-legged dog going up the ramp.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a plank ramp at a shingle shack's door with tinsel wound along its rail and colored string lights along the eave above, a small three-legged dog climbing the ramp, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
